chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Kufi, from Ali ibn al-Hasan, from Ali ibn Asbaat, from his uncle Ya'qub ibn Salim, from Abu Bakr al-Hadrami, who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the Words of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: 'Surely the most hateful of voices is the voice of the donkeys.' He (peace be upon him) said: 'The ugly sneezing.'
ai.seo_question: What does the 'ugly voice of the donkeys' in Surah Luqman refer to according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) offers a specific exegetical interpretation (tafsir) of Surah Luqman 31:19, identifying the 'ugliest of voices' not merely as the braying of donkeys, but as an unpleasant, uncultured sneezing sound. This highlights the Shia scholarly emphasis on refining physical manners (adab) as an extension of spiritual refinement, linking bodily etiquette to the broader Quranic theme of humility and avoiding arrogance in speech and conduct.
